Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.annotation

Annotation Interface AnalyticalRecipeParameter

@Target({}) @Retention(RUNTIME) public @interface AnalyticalRecipeParameter
Declares a single bounded adjustable parameter accepted by a VerifiedAnalyticalRecipe.

Runtime execution in POST /stats/recipes/{recipeId} is fail-closed: only parameter names declared here are accepted, and they may never override any field already fixed in lockedCriteria or lockedFilters.
